title: Two independent 20 s wall-clock budgets govern the handshake
description: Two independent 20 s wall-clock budgets govern the handshake. The worker thread's deadline starts before build_request spawns the extractor. The child's own 20 s poll starts only after it has written 'started'. On a loaded host where the interpreter start is slow, the worker gives up first, never writes 'ack', and the child exits 3. The test then reports EXTRACTION_FAILED with the message 'the GIL was held', although the GIL was never the cause. The failure is intermittent on loaded CI hosts and carries the wrong diagnosis.
